steps.title: How to Discover Government Assistance Effortlessly
steps.subtitle: No administrative complexity or language barrier should prevent you from receiving government benefits.
steps.step1Desc: Click the microphone button and talk about your family, occupation, or financial needs in your preferred language.
steps.step2Desc: Gemini Flash AI extracts your demographic criteria and searches verified databases via Tiger Data hybrid vector retrieval.
steps.step3Desc: Hear the spoken regional answer streamed via ElevenLabs, read along with high-contrast text, and apply directly.

about.title: Direct Welfare Access for Every Indian Citizen
about.p1: Millions of eligible citizens across rural and semi-urban India miss out on entitled subsidies, pensions, and medical grants simply because portal interfaces are English-dominated, form-heavy, and require digital literacy.
about.p2: YojanaSetu eliminates this bottleneck. By combining multimodal audio AI (Gemini Flash), ultra-fast semantic retrieval (Tiger Data pgvector), and natural regional voice generation (ElevenLabs), anyone who can speak can now unlock government support.
about.voiceDesc: Optimal for citizens who prefer speaking and listening over reading dense administrative text.
about.searchDesc: Ideal for operators, social workers, and citizens seeking precise multi-criteria filter drilling.

footer.platformDesc: An inclusive, AI-powered multilingual assistant helping every Indian citizen discover and apply for government welfare schemes without literacy or digital barriers.
footer.regionalDesc: Speak and listen with native speech synthesis powered by Gemini Flash and ElevenLabs:
footer.integrityDesc: Scheme data is ingested from verified government portals and gazettes. YojanaSetu does not charge any citizen fee for scheme discovery or application guidance.
